{{Weapon infobox | type = Longbow | level = 80 | salvage = none | rarity = Legendary | prefix = selectable | uslot = Superior Sigil of Celerity | bound = account use | skin = Kudzu (skin) | id = 30685 | gallery2 = Kudzu stowed.jpg | gallery2-text = Stowed. | gallery3 = Kudzu footfalls.jpg | gallery3-text = Flowery footfalls. }} [[Kudzu]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] [[longbow]] crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|When [[Secondborn]] Lonicera sacrificed herself to protect the [[Pale Tree]], a small root sprung from the ground where she breathed her final breath. That root took the shape of a mighty bow.}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Leaf of Kudzu | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of Kudzu | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Fortune | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Mastery }} == Graphics == [[Kudzu]] is a green longbow covered in flowers. Its riser takes the shape of a sylvari carrying a golden spear with a thistle texture overlay that pulses gold. While drawn, the bow sheds petals. ;Aura: * Pink leaves and sparkles swirl around forearms. ;Critical hit effects * Critical strikes while wielding Kudzu will cause flowers and leaves to blossom on your target(s). ;Draw/Stow effects * A birdsong is heard when drawing/stowing the bow. * A patch of grass and flowers appears at feet before fading, similar to the footfall effect but larger. ;Footfalls * The user leaves behind footprints of flowers and grass. ;Skill effects * A birdsong is heard upon firing the bow. * Default projectiles are replaced by the golden spear held by the sylvari, which leaves flower petals in its flight. This effect changes the following skills: **{{dragonhunter}} [[Dragonhunter]]: [[Spear of Justice]], [[Puncture Shot]], [[True Shot]], and [[Deflecting Shot]]. **{{r}} [[Ranger]]: [[Long Range Shot]], [[Rapid Fire]], [[Hunter's Shot]], [[Point-Blank Shot]], and [[Throw Dirt]] (downed skill). *** {{Soulbeast}} [[Soulbeast]]: any projectile from Soulbeast pet skills such as [[Narcotic Spores (soulbeast)|Narcotic Spores]]. **{{w}} [[Warrior]]: [[Dual Shot]], [[Fan of Fire]], [[Arcing Arrow]], [[Smoldering Arrow]], [[Pin Down]], and [[Throw Rock]] (downed skill). === Gallery === File:Kudzu draw animation.jpg|When first drawn. File:Kudzu aura.jpg|Kudzu's aura effect. File:Kudzu projectiles.jpg|Modified projectiles. File:Kudzu projectile trail.jpg|Flower trails on projectiles. File:Kudzu detail.jpg|Closeup of the riser shaped like a sylvari. It is also very invasive, hard to kill and has taken over much of the southern United States. * The [[Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns|Heart of Thorns]] expansion added new graphics to the bow (leaves and vines on drawing and forearm effect.) ** Additionally, the [[Rising Flames]] release replaced the normal black bowstring with a golden one. == See also == * [[Kudzu I: The Experimental Longbow]] - creating the first tier of the precursor, [[Kudzu Experiment]]. * [[Kudzu II: The Perfected Longbow]] - obtaining the second tier of the precursor, [[Perfected Longbow]]. * [[Kudzu III: Leaf of Kudzu]] - the final collection needed to be able to craft the precursor, [[Leaf of Kudzu]]. * [[Hidden Garden (landmark)]] - a harvest spot that gets unlocked {{Legendary weapon nav}} [[de:Kudzu]] [[es:Kudzu]] [[fr:Kudzu]]
